title: Why Sink Drains Gurgle After Flushing
description: When water travels through a drainage system without proper air intake, it creates a negative pressure vacuum. This siphon action pulls air through the nearest water trap, creating a distinct gurgling sound and compromising the trap seal. The root cause is almost always a blocked, improperly sized, or missing plumbing vent. Without air balancing atmospheric pressure from the vent stack, wastewater flow pulls air directly through fixture traps instead. Identifying gurgling early prevents sewer gas entry and preserves system drainage efficiency.

Why Sink Drains Gurgle After Flushing

When water travels through a drainage system without proper air intake, it creates a negative pressure vacuum. This siphon action pulls air through the nearest water trap, creating a distinct gurgling sound and compromising the trap seal. The root cause is almost always a blocked, improperly sized, or missing plumbing vent. Without air balancing atmospheric pressure from the vent stack, wastewater flow pulls air directly through fixture traps instead. Identifying gurgling early prevents sewer gas entry and preserves system drainage efficiency.
